summary: Comprehensive frontend Playwright testing of the PCF module. All 9 tabs switch/render, project row actions -> Open switches to Output Definition, data-quality drilldown dialog, wizard, readiness tracker, header primary button label per tab, inventory drawer + Add Activity flow with live compute + submit, recalc banner CHANGE DETECTED / RECALCULATION REQUIRED and Recalculate creates V1.1 and clears banner, calculation tree expand, allocation validate, boundary approve (BOUNDARY APPROVED), logistics sub-tabs + leg detail dialog + add-leg-dialog, hotspots scenario dialog with SIMULATION ONLY label, report Submit for Verification -> submit-confirm-dialog -> Submit & Lock -> SUBMITTED + MRV Verification Request Created, search filter on Projects table. Everything works.
critical_code_review_comments: Tabs component does not appear to expose data-state on the [data-testid=tab-*] TabsTrigger elements in a testable way (returns None). Non-blocking; content rendering was used to confirm active tab. Consider adding aria-selected or forwarding data-state for stronger test signals.
InventoryTab.jsx and CalculationTab.jsx approach ~180-240 lines; still within limits but keep an eye on growth.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only React demo at https://pcf-tema-ghana.preview.emergentagent.com. All flows confirmed working: 9 tabs, wizard, data-quality dialog, readiness tracker, header-primary button per tab, add-activity -> recalc banner -> Recalculate creates V1.1, allocation/boundary/logistics/hotspots/report submit flow all fully wired. For Radix DropdownMenu items (e.g. actions-PCF-GH-2026-001), use page.get_by_role('menuitem', name='Open') with a small wait after opening the trigger, since items render in a portal.
